name: dataset/urls.py
summary: Defines URL routing for the dataset application by registering DatasetViewSet with a Django REST framework DefaultRouter.
purpose: Exists to isolate dataset-specific API endpoint definitions within the application boundary, automatically mapping RESTful URL paths to DatasetViewSet actions and enabling clean integration into the project's root URL configuration via include().
responsibilities: Register DatasetViewSet with the DRF DefaultRouter
Auto-generate standard RESTful URL patterns for CRUD and custom actions
Export urlpatterns for inclusion in the root URLconf
Enforce separation of concerns by keeping routing logic independent of view implementation
inputs: DRF DefaultRouter instance and its configuration
Parent URL prefix and namespace via django.urls.include
outputs: Django urlpatterns list containing auto-generated API routes
REST endpoint URLs mapped to DatasetViewSet actions
architecture_notes: Implements the Django app-level URLconf pattern to enforce modularity, keeping dataset-specific routing self-contained inside the app. Uses Django REST framework's DefaultRouter to apply Resource-Oriented Architecture (REST) conventions, automatically deriving URL patterns from the ViewSet interface. The unidirectional dependency on views.DatasetViewSet indicates a layered architecture where the transport/routing layer depends on the presentation layer but not vice versa. Integration via include() suggests a hierarchical routing tree managed at the project level, supporting potential API versioning or multi-app composition without tight coupling.
improvements: Add app_name to support URL namespacing and reverse URL resolution
Explicitly pass basename='dataset' to router.register() to decouple URL names from ViewSet queryset or model metadata
Add docstrings explaining the endpoint conventions and actions exposed by DefaultRouter
Consider API versioning (e.g., v1/) either at the app level or in the root urls.py to future-proof the contract
Add type hints for urlpatterns to improve static analysis and IDE support
